chapters.title: Postorder sum with an accumulator
chapters.code:
def find_tilt(root):
    total = 0

    def subtree_sum(node):
        nonlocal total
        if node is None:
            return 0
        left = subtree_sum(node.left)
        right = subtree_sum(node.right)
        total += abs(left - right)        # this node's tilt
        return node.val + left + right    # what the parent needs

    subtree_sum(root)
    return total

frames.caption: Postorder sum with an accumulator — O(n) time, O(h) extra space. Input: find_tilt(root=tree (4)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
